map.输入系统额定/实测压力、泄漏量、振动频率、油温，基于规则推理诊断液压系统可能故障: Diagnose likely hydraulic faults from rated and measured pressure, internal leakage, dominant vibration frequency and oil temperature, with rule-based causes and repair advice.
map.压降率 = (额定压力 Pr − 实测压力 Pa) ÷ Pr × 100%；判定: Pressure-drop rate = (rated pressure Pr − measured pressure Pa) ÷ Pr × 100%; thresholds: >5% triggers insufficient pressure (>30% severe / >15% moderate / else slight); internal leakage >500 mL/min severe, >200 high; oil temp >85°C overheating, >70 elevated; vibration >200 Hz suspected cavitation, >50 pump pulsation, else mechanical looseness
map.按规则推理诊断液压系统故障。以压降率为主线索：压降超过 5% 判定系统压力不足，: Diagnose hydraulic faults by rule-based reasoning, with pressure-drop rate as the main clue: pressure drop over 5% indicates insufficient system pressure; combined with internal leakage, oil temp and dominant vibration frequency locate the root cause — large leakage points to seal damage, medium leakage to spool wear, small leakage mostly to low relief valve setting; high oil temp is mostly insufficient cooling; vibration is split by band into cavitation, pump pulsation and mechanical looseness. When multiple factors combine (pressure drop >15% and oil temp >75°C), it is judged as overall system efficiency drop needing full overhaul.
map.💡 规则推理：压力偏差>5%判为压力不足；内泄漏>200mL/min 偏大，>5: 💡 Rule reasoning: pressure deviation >5% judged as insufficient pressure; internal leakage >200 mL/min high, >500 severe; oil temp >70°C elevated, >85°C overheating; vibration classified low/mid/high frequency
map.本工具为规则推理辅助诊断，结论仅供参考，需结合现场检测综合判断: This tool is a rule-based diagnostic aid; conclusions are for reference only and must be judged together with on-site testing.
map.内泄漏量可通过容积效率测试或流量计测量: Internal leakage can be measured by volumetric efficiency test or flow meter
map.振动频率建议用测振仪采集主频成分: For vibration frequency, use a vibration meter to capture the dominant component
map.油温为工作状态下的稳定油箱温度: Oil temperature is the stable tank temperature under working state
map.压力上不去的因果定位（泵/溢流/内漏）。: Cause locating for low pressure (pump/relief/internal leak).
map.动作迟缓与噪声的关联分析。: Correlation of sluggish action and noise.
map.按压力-流量曲线判元件退化。: Judge component degradation by pressure-flow curve.
map.设定 16 MPa 实测 10 MPa，先查溢流阀弹簧是否失效、再查泵内泄与缸外: Set 16 MPa measured 10 MPa; first check if relief valve spring failed, then pump internal leak and cylinder external leak, isolate step by step.
map.保压 500 s 掉 2 MPa，多为单向阀或缸密封泄漏，非泵问题。: Hold 500 s drops 2 MPa, mostly one-way valve or cylinder seal leakage, not a pump issue.
map.用切断法分段隔离：锁泵、锁阀、锁缸看压力恢复点，定位故障元件。: Use cut-off method to isolate sections: lock pump, lock valve, lock cylinder and watch pressure recovery point to locate the faulty component.
map.气蚀与吸入不足常伴噪声且压力不稳，优先查油位与吸油管。: Cavitation and insufficient suction often come with noise and unstable pressure; check oil level and suction pipe first.
map.液压故障诊断工具基于规则推理（专家系统思路），输入系统压力、泄漏量、振动频率、油: The hydraulic fault diagnosis tool uses rule-based reasoning (expert-system approach). Input operating parameters such as system pressure, leakage, vibration frequency and oil temperature to automatically identify common hydraulic faults like insufficient pressure, internal leakage, oil overheating, cavitation and resonance, and give cause analysis and repair advice, aiding fast on-site troubleshooting.
map.设备状态监测与预测维护: Equipment condition monitoring and predictive maintenance
